currency_assumptions: Venue prices are researched and stored in JPY (cost_local_amount / cost_local_currency = JPY). Every USD figure uses the ECB euro foreign exchange reference rates dated 2026-11-27 and fetched 2026-11-28: EUR 1 = USD 1.0957 and EUR 1 = JPY 174.81, giving USD 1 = JPY 159.5418 and JPY 1 = USD 0.00626795. See fx_evidence_2026-11-28.md for the derived cross rate and the hand recomputations.

Where a venue publishes a full-day or 終日 band, that printed amount is recorded (MyDome 第1・第2会議室 and 第3会議室 on the post-2027-04-01 table, エル・おおさか 9012/708, 生涯学習センター and 市民学習センター Saturday 全日 rows, 大阪産業創造館 weekend 終日, 大阪市立中央会館 holiday 全日, 港区民センター holiday 全日). Where a Saturday surcharge is printed as a multiplier (中央公会堂 and the ward/lifelong-learning halls: 土日祝は2割増), the recorded amount is the printed weekday all-day figure multiplied by that printed multiplier. Where only an hourly rate exists (大阪商工会議所), the amount is that rate multiplied by 8 hours and the record carries cost_basis estimated_from_rate with estimated_hours 8 and a final-quote question.

Where no readable price exists, estimated_cost_usd is null with a cost_unknown question: 大阪カンファレンスセンター 中会議室 銀杏 publishes its fee table only as a PDF (shisetsu_fee.pdf) and this environment has no PDF text extractor.
holiday_and_school_context_note: Only the JP public holiday rows and the JP:osaka school rows in the plan-event registry edition 2026-11-28 are used for date context; no Japanese holiday or school-break date is stated in this package from any other source. The registry is read-only for this run and no candidate Saturday is selected, ranked or recommended.
open_questions: No date is selected, ranked or recommended in this run. The whole 2027 calendar year was swept and the venue set is date-independent; every venue carries its own Saturday-availability question.

Osaka's venue market splits into public/civic halls with published fee tables (マイドームおおさか, 大阪市中央公会堂, エル・おおさか, 大阪市立生涯学習センター, 大阪産業創造館, 港区民センター, 中央会館) and commercial or institutional rooms that publish nothing readable (大阪カンファレンスセンター) or are unreachable from this worker (大阪産業創造館's main www host returned 403; innovation-osaka.jp timed out on both www and apex).

Two hosts central to the brief could not be read: innovation-osaka.jp (Osaka Innovation Hub and the Tech Osaka Summit organiser) timed out on every attempt, and intex-osaka.com timed out on the Intex Osaka price page. No OIH or Intex venue record is therefore claimed, and the Tech Osaka Summit 2027 dates seen only in search snippets are not written into the calendar.

Alcohol is an event-licence question, not a room amenity: none of the 16 venue pages publishes an alcohol permission for a rented hall, so every record carries an explicit licence question. 大阪市中央公会堂's 中集会室 page does describe 'ケータリングを入れてのパーティー' as a use case, which is the only catering-with-drinks language found.

The 09:00 start is the binding constraint in this market: most municipal halls open at 09:30 (公会堂, 生涯学習センター, 産業創造館, 港区民センター, 中央会館, マイドーム's 午前 band is 09:00 but 生涯学習 is 09:30), and only エル・おおさか publishes a 09:00-21:00 全日 band. A 12-hour 09:00-21:00 day is possible at エル・おおさか as printed and at マイドーム within its 09:00-21:00 終日 band.

Osaka's 2027 AI/Web3 calendar is thin on organiser-published dates: Japan IT Week 関西 (2027-11-17..19) and 大阪マラソン (2027-02-28) are confirmed, AI-ESS-16 (2027-09-13..17) is confirmed, and Osaka Innovation Hub events, Intex Osaka's 2027 schedule and the Tech Osaka Summit could not be verified from organiser pages from this worker.
Nothing here is a booking, a hold, or a partner commitment. Every community contact route recorded is a public page, and only QUINTBRIDGE carries explicit own-page co-hosting language.

recommendation.rationale: Run A evidence package only. No venue is selected and no date is proposed; Joe decides both from the evidence. The scorer's tiers are recorded in venues.shortlist.json with the ECB-based USD costs.
